history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration systematically document the review and the update of volume II employee benefits actuarial assumptions, providing appropriate evidence as necessary, to ensure their reasonableness before using them in the valuation.
history.administration_response: The Administration reviewed all assumptions with the actuary for the full valuation of end-of-service liabilities as at 31 December 2023 and is working on the formal document by analysing the significant and other assumptions as defined under IPSAS 39. The document will also cover the source, nature and applicability of assumptions and set out the frequency of their review and alignment with the existing actuarial process and timeline. The implementation is on track to be completed by the target date.
history.board_assessment: Because work is ongoing, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation, noting that the target date has be postponed to 2025.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration systematically document the review and the update of volume II employee benefits actuarial assumptions, providing appropriate evidence as necessary, to ensure their reasonableness before using them in the valuation.
history.administration_response: The frequency of reviewing and updating assumptions is documented in the policy paper and the assumptions paper. In addition, the assumptions letter issued by the external actuary, in consultation with the Administration, outlines the process for reviewing and updating assumptions prior to each valuation. In the light of this, the Administration requests that the Board consider closing this recommendation, given that the recommendation in paragraph 274 of A/77/5 (Vol. II) already addresses the same subject matter.
history.board_assessment: As with the previous recommendation, this recommendation will be closed when the two papers are issued.

history.sg_progress: Please refer to number 17 in annex II to the Board’s report A/80/5 (Vol. II) for the Administration’s comments. The Administration is actively working to implement the current recommendation in conjunction with the actions outlined in the recommendation in paragraph 274 of A/77/5 (Vol. II). All relevant actuarial assumptions are comprehensively presented within the Organization’s policies and assumptions paper. These assumptions are further supported and validated by the actuary’s letter provided at the time of the annual valuation. Management has communicated to the Board that there is significant overlap between this recommendation and the recommendation in paragraph 274 of A/77/5 (Vol. II). For that reason, the Administration requested the closure of this recommendation, but the Board indicated that both recommendations would be closed together once all related matters were addressed.
